[01-06] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오. (교재 p.220)
I'm (A)blind. I walk with a (B)stick. One day, my (C)homeroom teacher said, "There will be a school event, (D)Friendship Marathon. In this event, two people run as a team." Everyone talked about it. I also got interesting. "But can I run?" I was not (E)sure. (a) ______ I talked about it (b) ______ my best friend, Junha. He said, "Don't worry! I'll run (c) ______ you."

During the marathon, I ran with Andy and guided him (a)______ the same time. It was hard, but we didn't stop (b)______. At last, (c)we made it to the finish line! We didn't win the race. But I knew (d)what we did our best. Finishing something was not easy for me. But this time I did it! I was very happy. Andy looked happy, too.

20 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 윗글의 빈칸 (a)에 들어갈 말과 다른 것은?
choices: Look ______ the sky! It's so beautiful.
I'm tired ______ the end of the day.
I have an English test ______ Monday.
The train arrived ______ the station late.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④ on. (a)는 during이고, ④만 on이 들어간다. (교재 p.223 20)
